question: The Easter basket is related to which of the following religions?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Christianity**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The **Easter basket** is associated with the celebration of **Easter**, which is a significant festival in **Christianity**.
 
• Easter commemorates the **resurrection of Jesus Christ** from the dead, which is considered a cornerstone event in Christian beliefs.
 
• Traditionally, Easter baskets are filled with **decorated eggs, candies, and other treats** as part of the celebration.
 
• The use of baskets during Easter has origins in **European traditions**, where people carried their Easter feast foods to church to be blessed.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Easter** is celebrated on the first Sunday after the first full moon following the vernal equinox, which can fall between March 22 and April 25.
 
• It is preceded by the 40-day period of fasting, prayer, and penance called **Lent**, culminating in **Holy Week**, which includes **Good Friday** (commemorating the crucifixion of Jesus) and **Easter Sunday**.
 
• The Easter egg is a symbol of new life and rebirth, aligning with the theme of resurrection.
 
• In many cultures, Easter is also associated with various folk traditions, such as the Easter Bunny, which is said to bring Easter eggs.
